subject.title: Export installed agents as grouped Claw packages

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this experimental installed-agent export command and grouped portable package identity contract as part of the pending Claws RFC?
rationale: The implementation introduces a new user-facing CLI workflow and portable package contract whose long-term ownership and compatibility cannot be decided from correctness review alone.

options.title: Approve the experimental slice
options.body: Accept the export direction after the base lifecycle PR is ready and exact-head real CLI proof is posted.

options.title: Narrow the export contract
options.body: Limit the first version to manifest and managed sidecars while deferring recorded package-identity preservation until the RFC settles it.

options.title: Pause with the RFC
options.body: Keep the draft stacked but do not land it until the grouped Claw product contract is explicitly approved.

recommendation.title: Approve the experimental slice
recommendation.body: Accept the export direction after the base lifecycle PR is ready and exact-head real CLI proof is posted.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the most directly evidenced reviewer of this export contract, though final product authority is not established by the available history.
